captions.detailed: This 3D model features a compact, multi-segmented fold-out support arm mounted on a flat, rectangular base plate. The assembly includes four dark grey, box-shaped arm links connected in series, terminating in a light grey platform bracket. Each of the four joints is designed to rotate about parallel axes in a single plane, allowing the arm to collapse tightly against the base or unfold to extend outward.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact fold-out support arm with four segments. It should feature a flat, dark grey base plate, four sequential box-section links, and a light grey end-effector platform bracket, all connected via revolute joints that allow the arm to fold flat or extend.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining a base plate using box primitives. It then models four sequential links (link1, link2, link3, link4) as dark-colored rectangular solids, adding small cylindrical or block-like joint protrusions. A final end-effector bracket is created as a separate part in light grey. These components are systematically linked together using five revolute joints (including the joint to the base and the final joint to the platform) with specified rotation axes and limits to enable planar folding.
